subject: an Indian emperor of the Maurya period, 3rd century BC, with a neat moustache and calm grave eyes, wearing a draped white cotton dhoti, a light shawl over one shoulder, a large wrapped turban-style headdress with a central jewel, heavy gold earrings and armlets, bare feet or simple sandals

panels.01-pataliputra: the ancient Maurya capital Pataliputra on the wide Ganges river around 304 BC, long wooden palisade walls and timber gate towers, wooden palace halls with carved pillars, boats on the river, crowds in draped cotton garments, wide establishing shot at golden hour
panels.02-ujjain: a young {S} as a prince of about twenty seated on a low wooden throne in a provincial hall at Ujjain, listening to petitioners and officials in draped garments, palm-leaf records on a low table, ancient India 3rd century BC, attentive and serious
panels.03-kalinga: {S} standing alone on a hill above a quiet battlefield at dusk after the Kalinga war in 261 BC, broken spears and abandoned shields in the grass, a river below, families of captives being led away in the distance, smoke rising from far villages, his head bowed in sorrow, no bodies, no blood, sombre and dignified
panels.04-bodhgaya: {S} kneeling respectfully with folded hands before a great pipal tree with a simple stone platform beneath it at Bodh Gaya, Buddhist monks in saffron robes standing quietly nearby, flower offerings, soft morning light, ancient India 3rd century BC, reverent and calm
panels.05-dhauli: {S} standing beside a large rock on a hill near a river, watching stone-cutters with chisels and mallets carefully carving lines of ancient Brahmi-style letters into the smoothed rock face, a front part of the rock carved into the shape of an elephant, scribes holding palm-leaf drafts, local villagers gathered to listen as an official reads aloud, Kalinga 3rd century BC, hopeful and solemn
panels.06-mission: a young Buddhist monk in saffron robes and four elder monks boarding a wooden sailing ship at an ancient Indian harbour around 250 BC, {S} standing on the shore with officials, raising his hand in farewell, calm sea and morning sun
panels.07-pillar: {S} watching workers use ropes, wooden rollers and scaffolding to raise a tall polished sandstone pillar at a Buddhist site, a carved capital of four lions waiting on a wooden cart, stone masons polishing the shaft, banyan trees and a road with travellers and a well beside it, ancient India 3rd century BC, grand and purposeful
panels.08-farewell: an aged {S} with a grey moustache seated quietly in a simple palace garden at Pataliputra around 232 BC, holding a palm-leaf manuscript, monks and ministers standing respectfully at a distance, a stone pillar with a lion capital far in the background, warm evening light, dignified farewell
